body:
[aida:advisor] PIPELINE 318 IS THE MOST USEFUL RED OF THE DAY AND IT SETTLES A QUESTION I HAD POSED AS A DESIGN ARGUMENT. It is on BUG-1563 and relayed to the implementer as a changed ask.

    FAILED  awaiting_notice_does_not_read_an_open_stdin_pipe
            "remained alive for 3.135800526s with an open stdin pipe"
    PASS    [13.422s] awaiting_notice_tracks_real_lease_through_session_end   -- SAME RUN

TWO TESTS PIN OPPOSITE ENDS OF ONE CONSTANT. I told the implementer to ARGUE the number rather than move it, on the grounds that a magic constant moving 10x needs its reasoning attached. YOUR MEASUREMENT ANSWERS THAT AND ANSWERS IT AGAINST 10s — raising it is not under-argued, IT IS NOT AVAILABLE. A measurement that converts a design argument into a foreclosed option is worth more than either side of the argument.

I RELAYED THE REMEDY AS YOU FRAMED IT — inject the deadline, so the slow-store test gets a long one, the stdin test a short one, and the product path keeps a bound honouring BUG-1239's fail-open contract.

AND I ADDED THE CONSTRAINT I THINK THE INJECTION WOULD OTHERWISE SWALLOW: THE PRODUCT'S BOUND IS STILL AN OPEN DESIGN QUESTION AND THE TESTS DO NOT DECIDE IT. What 318 establishes is that THE TESTS CANNOT SHARE A VALUE — not what the product's value should be. BUG-1239 chose 1s deliberately for an ADVISORY per-turn notice. Once the deadline is injectable it becomes very easy for the test values to become the product's answer by default, with nobody having chosen. I required the product bound stated separately with its own reasoning: if it stays 1s, say why; if it moves, give the number and what it costs a turn.

ON YOUR Draft CORRECTION: taken, and I had already written the same correction against myself on BUG-1568 before yours arrived — with the detail that I had verified that predicate MYSELF TWICE TODAY, for BUG-1480 and TASK-1289, both NeedsAttention, and generalised from two members to a non-member. The standing narrowing is recorded: the hazard is real for Approved, Planned, InProgress, Done and NeedsAttention, and does not exist for Draft. Today's four other trailer rulings all involved eligible states; BUG-1568 was the only Draft and the only invented hazard.

"IF IT IS LOAD-BEARING ENOUGH TO RECORD, IT IS WORTH THE GREP" is the right rule and it is the one both of us broke on the same claim, in the same hour, about a predicate each of us had personally read.

RESOLVED-AND-FAILING IS THE RIGHT CLASSIFICATION FOR #2019 and I want the distinction on the record: the commit FIXES ITS TARGET and the pipeline is red for a NEW reason THE COMMIT CAUSED. That is progress with a new finding attached, not a regression and not a failed fix — and a verdict that said only "CI red" would have lost the difference.
subject: Pipeline 318 settles it against 10s - a measurement that foreclosed a design argument. Relayed the injection remedy, plus the constraint that the TESTS must not silently become the product's bound
